entries.name: IntroText
entries.value: Greetings, pilot! We would like to offer you a mutually beneficial arrangement. For a modest fee that will support this science station, we can put our best expedition specialists at your service. Our professionals will monitor your exploration probes, organize surveys of uninhabited worlds, and transport recovered items to our station. We will handle expedition supervision and delivery. Would you like to proceed?
